title: Fully discrete scheme for the fifth-order KdV-Burgers-Fisher equation using Strang splitting and Fourier collocation methods
summary: Operator splitting is an effective technique for the numerical solution of nonlinear partial differential equations by decomposing a complex problem into simpler subproblems. In this study, we present and analyze a fully discrete scheme for the fifth-order Korteweg-de Vries-Burgers-Fisher equation (KBF) by combining Strang splitting for time discretization with the Fourier collocation method for spatial discretization. In particular, the Fourier collocation method is an essential component of the proposed fully discrete scheme and yields spectral accuracy in space under suitable regularity…
